--- title: BirdNET model fitting subtitle: Bellbird mimicry author: Marcelo Araya-Salas date: "2026-11-19" toc: true toc-depth: 3 toc-location: left number-sections: true highlight-style: pygments format: html: df-print: kable code-fold: true code-tools: true css: qmd.css editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) library(ggplot2) library(viridis) library(knitr) theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14)) source("scripts/birdnet_cv_functions.R") models <- c("sympatric_and_allopatric", "sympatric") model_labels <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "Sympatric + allopatric", sympatric = "Sympatric only") configs <- c("A", "B", "C") short <- function(x) ifelse(x == "Unassigned", x, sub("^(\\w)\\w+ ", "\\1. ", x)) ``` ::: # Purpose - Train the two custom BirdNET classifiers from code, with a fixed random seed (123), so the fitting is reproducible - Choose the hyperparameters and the classification thresholds, and estimate the performance of the classifiers, by 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording - Classify the vocalizations of other bellbirds and of the focal bellbird with models that never heard them The two classifiers are: - **Sympatric + allopatric**: the three sympatric species the bellbird could have imitated (Keel-billed Toucan, Collared Aracari and Montezuma Oropendola), their closely related allopatric species (Choco Toucan, Pale-mandibled Aracari and Chestnut-headed Oropendola) and the Three-wattled Bellbird - **Sympatric only**: the three sympatric species and the Three-wattled Bellbird # Data 2 s clips exported in [Data preparation](birdnet_acoustic_data_prep.qmd). All clips are used for cross-validation; each recording contributes several clips. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} folds <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "folds.csv")) clips <- aggregate(clip ~ species, folds, length) names(clips) <- c("Species", "Clips") clips$Recordings <- as.integer(tapply(folds$recording, folds$species, function(x) length(unique(x)))[clips$Species]) clips$Type <- ifelse(clips$Species %in% sympatric_spp, "Sympatric", "Allopatric") clips$Type[clips$Species == "Procnias tricarunculatus"] <- "Bellbird" clips[, c("Species", "Type", "Recordings", "Clips")] ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
|Species |Type | Recordings| Clips| |:--------------------------|:----------|----------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus |Bellbird | 59| 800| |Psarocolius guatimozinus |Allopatric | 15| 410| |Psarocolius montezuma |Sympatric | 42| 815| |Pteroglossus erythropygius |Allopatric | 45| 866| |Pteroglossus torquatus |Sympatric | 35| 462| |Ramphastos brevis |Allopatric | 36| 808| |Ramphastos sulfuratus |Sympatric | 27| 1356|
::: ::: # Cross-validation design - The clips were split into 5 folds with a stratified group k-fold (seed 123): all clips of a recording fall in the same fold, and the folds are balanced by species. Five folds keep about 3 recordings of the species with fewest recordings (*P. guatimozinus*, 15) in each fold - For each fold, the classifiers were trained on the other 4 folds and classified the held-out fold, so every clip has one out-of-fold prediction from a model that never heard its recording - Training stops early on a random 20% of the training clips (the held-out fold is not used for training in any way), up to 50 epochs; the weights of the best epoch are kept - Training and classification use a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass, BirdNET-Analyzer v2.4 and seed 123 - Three hyperparameter configurations were compared for each classifier: - **A**: 2,048 hidden units, dropout 0.5, batch size 64, learning rate 0.001, mixup and focal loss (α 0.75, γ 0.5) - **B**: 256 hidden units, dropout 0.5, batch size 16, learning rate 0.002, mixup and upsampling of the rare classes to 33% of the largest one - **C**: BirdNET defaults: linear classifier (no hidden layer), no dropout, batch size 32, learning rate 0.0001, no mixup, upsampling or focal loss - The selection rule was set before looking at the results: the configuration with the highest macro-averaged AUPRC on the out-of-fold predictions (threshold-free), judged separately for each classifier - Per-species thresholds are the ones that maximize F1 on the out-of-fold predictions (0.05 steps); a clip is assigned to the species with the highest confidence if it reaches that species' threshold, otherwise it is left unassigned The whole pipeline is run with [`scripts/birdnet_cv.sh`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/birdnet_cv.sh). It assigns the folds with [`scripts/birdnet_cv_folds.py`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/birdnet_cv_folds.py) and trains through [`scripts/train_birdnet.py`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/train_birdnet.py), a wrapper of BirdNET-Analyzer that seeds Python, NumPy and TensorFlow (weights, shuffling, dropout, mixup), turns on deterministic TensorFlow operations and saves the training history. Re-running the training with the same seed gives the same models up to floating-point rounding. ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code code-fold="false"} # from the project root bash scripts/birdnet_cv.sh all # folds, 30 trainings (3 configurations x 2 classifiers x 5 folds) and classifications ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cv_res <- list() for (cf in configs) for (m in models) { sc <- oof_scores(cf, m, folds) spp <- model_spp[[m]] thr <- optimal_thresholds(sc, spp) cv_res[[cf]][[m]] <- list(scores = sc, thr = thr, metrics = cv_metrics(sc, spp, thr), folds = fold_metrics(sc, spp, thr)) } ``` ::: ## Folds ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ft <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(folds$species, folds$fold)) names(ft) <- paste("Fold", names(ft)) rec <- tapply(paste(folds$species, folds$recording), folds$fold, function(x) length(unique(x))) rbind(ft, Recordings = as.integer(rec), `Total clips` = colSums(ft)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
| | Fold 1| Fold 2| Fold 3| Fold 4| Fold 5| |:--------------------------|------:|------:|------:|------:|------:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 160| 160| 160| 160| 160| |Psarocolius guatimozinus | 83| 83| 81| 82| 81| |Psarocolius montezuma | 163| 163| 163| 163| 163| |Pteroglossus erythropygius | 173| 172| 174| 174| 173| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 92| 92| 93| 93| 92| |Ramphastos brevis | 162| 161| 163| 161| 161| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 273| 278| 266| 271| 268| |Recordings | 53| 53| 51| 54| 48| |Total clips | 1106| 1109| 1100| 1104| 1098|
::: ::: # Comparison of configurations Out-of-fold macro-averaged AUPRC and F1 (thresholds from the out-of-fold predictions). Error bars: standard deviation across folds. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cmp_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(configs, function(cf) do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_res[[cf]][[m]] data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], Configuration = cf, AUPRC = r$metrics$macro[["AUPRC"]], `AUPRC SD` = sd(r$folds$AUPRC), F1 = r$metrics$macro[["F1"]], `F1 SD` = sd(r$folds$F1), Accuracy = r$metrics$macro[["accuracy"]], check.names = FALSE) })))) cmp_cv$Model <- factor(cmp_cv$Model, levels = model_labels) best_cfg <- sapply(models, function(m) { d <- cmp_cv[cmp_cv$Model == model_labels[[m]], ] d$Configuration[order(-d$AUPRC, -d$F1)[1]] }) cmp_cv$Selected <- ifelse(cmp_cv$Configuration == best_cfg[match(cmp_cv$Model, model_labels)], "✓", "") long <- rbind(data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro AUPRC", value = cmp_cv$AUPRC, sd = cmp_cv$`AUPRC SD`), data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro F1", value = cmp_cv$F1, sd = cmp_cv$`F1 SD`)) ggplot(long, aes(Configuration, value, color = Configuration)) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd), size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) + facet_grid(metric ~ Model, scales = "free_y") + scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.8, guide = "none") + labs(x = "Configuration", y = "") + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/cv comparison-1.png){width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kable(cmp_cv[order(cmp_cv$Model), ], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Model |Configuration | AUPRC| AUPRC SD| F1| F1 SD| Accuracy|Selected | |:----------------------|:-------------|-----:|--------:|-----:|-----:|--------:|:--------| |Sympatric + allopatric |A | 0.881| 0.045| 0.822| 0.047| 0.822|✓ | |Sympatric + allopatric |B | 0.875| 0.038| 0.805| 0.041| 0.807| | |Sympatric + allopatric |C | 0.853| 0.035| 0.799| 0.035| 0.804| | |Sympatric only |A | 0.987| 0.003| 0.939| 0.021| 0.907| | |Sympatric only |B | 0.986| 0.005| 0.930| 0.015| 0.901| | |Sympatric only |C | 0.991| 0.007| 0.947| 0.021| 0.920|✓ | ::: ::: Selected configurations: **A** for the sympatric + allopatric classifier and **C** for the sympatric-only classifier. The differences between configurations are small compared with the variation across folds. ## Training history of the selected configurations Each line is one fold. Validation: the random 20% of the training clips used for early stopping. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hist <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k) { h <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "models", best_cfg[[m]], m, paste0("fold_", k), paste0(m, "_history.csv"))) data.frame(model = paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")"), fold = k, epoch = rep(h$epoch, 4), metric = rep(c("Loss", "Loss", "AUPRC", "AUPRC"), each = nrow(h)), set = rep(c("Training", "Validation", "Training", "Validation"), each = nrow(h)), value = c(h$loss, h$val_loss, h$AUPRC, h$val_AUPRC)) })))) hist$model <- factor(hist$model, levels = unique(hist$model)) ggplot(hist, aes(epoch, value, color = set, group = interaction(set, fold))) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) + facet_grid(metric ~ model, scales = "free") + scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.7, name = "") + labs(x = "Epoch", y = "") + theme(legend.position = "top", strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/training history-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: # Performance of the selected configurations ```{.r .cell-code} for (m in models) { r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]] ps <- r$metrics$per_species names(ps) <- c("Species", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "AUPRC", "Threshold", "Clips") cat("\n\n##", model_labels[[m]], "(configuration", best_cfg[[m]], ")\n\n") print(kable(ps, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)) } ``` ## Sympatric + allopatric (configuration A ) |Species | Precision| Recall| F1| AUPRC| Threshold| Clips| |:--------------------------|---------:|------:|-----:|-----:|---------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 0.949| 0.951| 0.950| 0.988| 0.85| 800| |Psarocolius guatimozinus | 0.663| 0.805| 0.727| 0.782| 0.45| 410| |Psarocolius montezuma | 0.955| 0.632| 0.761| 0.888| 0.15| 815| |Pteroglossus erythropygius | 0.809| 0.809| 0.809| 0.876| 0.45| 866| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0.696| 0.569| 0.626| 0.665| 0.25| 462| |Ramphastos brevis | 0.964| 0.902| 0.932| 0.986| 0.40| 808| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 0.988| 0.911| 0.948| 0.986| 0.15| 1356| ## Sympatric only (configuration C ) |Species | Precision| Recall| F1| AUPRC| Threshold| Clips| |:------------------------|---------:|------:|-----:|-----:|---------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 0.964| 0.935| 0.949| 0.989| 0.60| 800| |Psarocolius montezuma | 0.983| 0.921| 0.951| 0.991| 0.25| 815| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0.969| 0.892| 0.929| 0.994| 0.15| 462| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 0.997| 0.920| 0.957| 0.989| 0.10| 1356| ## Confusion matrices ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cv_conf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]] tb <- as.data.frame(table(true = r$scores$true, predicted = r$metrics$pred)) tb$prop <- tb$Freq / ave(tb$Freq, tb$true, FUN = sum) tb$model <- paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")") tb })) cv_conf$model <- factor(cv_conf$model, levels = unique(cv_conf$model)) cv_conf$true <- short(as.character(cv_conf$true)) cv_conf$predicted <- short(as.character(cv_conf$predicted)) ggplot(cv_conf, aes(predicted, true, fill = prop)) + geom_tile(color = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Freq > 0, Freq, "")), size = 3.5, color = ifelse(cv_conf$prop > 0.5, "black", "white")) + facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free") + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", limits = c(0, 1), name = "Proportion\nof true class") + labs(x = "Predicted", y = "True", title = "Out-of-fold predictions") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/cv confusion-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: ## Other bellbirds Every recording of other bellbirds gets an out-of-fold prediction, so the control uses all 800 bellbird clips. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ob <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]] p <- r$metrics$pred[r$scores$true == "Procnias tricarunculatus"] data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], `Classified as` = names(table(p)), Clips = as.integer(table(p)), check.names = FALSE) })) ob ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}
|Model |Classified as | Clips| |:----------------------|:--------------------------|-----:| |Sympatric + allopatric |Procnias tricarunculatus | 761| |Sympatric + allopatric |Psarocolius guatimozinus | 1| |Sympatric + allopatric |Psarocolius montezuma | 4| |Sympatric + allopatric |Pteroglossus erythropygius | 1| |Sympatric + allopatric |Ramphastos brevis | 1| |Sympatric + allopatric |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 2| |Sympatric + allopatric |Unassigned | 30| |Sympatric only |Procnias tricarunculatus | 748| |Sympatric only |Psarocolius montezuma | 2| |Sympatric only |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 4| |Sympatric only |Unassigned | 46|
::: ::: # Focal bellbird classification The 1660 focal bellbird clips are classified with the 5 fold models of the selected configuration: the confidence of each species is averaged across the 5 models (ensemble) and the out-of-fold thresholds are applied. The predictions are saved in `data/processed/birdnet_cv/focal_predictions_.csv`, and the out-of-fold predictions of the reference clips in `data/processed/birdnet_cv/oof_predictions_.csv`; both are used in the [statistical analysis](statistical_analysis_cv.qmd). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} focal_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { cf <- best_cfg[[m]] en <- ensemble_scores(cf, m) en$predicted <- assign_species(en, model_spp[[m]], cv_res[[cf]][[m]]$thr) write.csv(en, file.path(cv_dir, paste0("focal_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE) data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], predicted = en$predicted) })) # out-of-fold predictions of the reference clips, for downstream use for (m in models) { r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]] write.csv(data.frame(r$scores, predicted = r$metrics$pred, check.names = FALSE), file.path(cv_dir, paste0("oof_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE) } fc_tab <- as.data.frame(table(focal_cv$model, focal_cv$predicted)) names(fc_tab) <- c("Model", "Classified as", "Clips") fc_tab[fc_tab$Clips > 0, ] ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fp <- fc_tab[fc_tab$Clips > 0, ] fp$`Classified as` <- short(as.character(fp$`Classified as`)) ggplot(fp, aes(`Classified as`, Clips, fill = Model)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"), width = 0.75) + scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.6, name = "") + labs(x = "", y = "Focal bellbird clips") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), legend.position = "top") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](birdnet_model_fitting_files/figure-html/focal plot-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sa <- focal_cv[focal_cv$model == model_labels[["sympatric_and_allopatric"]], "predicted"] allo <- c("Psarocolius guatimozinus", "Pteroglossus erythropygius", "Ramphastos brevis") symp_het <- setdiff(sympatric_spp, "Procnias tricarunculatus") sh <- c(Sympatric = sum(sa %in% symp_het), Allopatric = sum(sa %in% allo)) data.frame(t(sh), `% sympatric` = round(100 * sh[[1]] / sum(sh), 1), `Sympatric : allopatric` = round(sh[[1]] / sh[[2]], 1), check.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: # Takeaways - Both classifiers were trained from code with a fixed seed (123); re-running gives the same models up to floating-point rounding - 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording selected configuration A for the sympatric + allopatric classifier (out-of-fold macro AUPRC 0.881) and C for the sympatric-only classifier (0.991); differences between configurations are within fold-to-fold variation - The weakest classes are the aracaris and the oropendolas in the sympatric + allopatric classifier, where each is confused with its close relative (*P. torquatus* with *P. erythropygius* above all);
